semiconductor_relevance: High — Toho International Inc. specializes in semiconductor testing solutions, providing critical products and services for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Toho International Inc. offers high-quality semiconductor testing solutions, including customized test sockets, contact probes, and probe cards. Their products are designed for various semiconductor packages and support both manual and automated testing applications.

Spring contact probes for reliability and performance evaluations
High-frequency probes for RF signal integrity
Heat-resistant 'Dragon Probes' for elevated temperature measurements
technical_expertise: IC test socket design and manufacturing
